# MidwayBatchAccount

<!-- generated by scripts/render.mjs from data/ ; do not edit -->

Submits a capped, paced campaign of Midway acquisitions for one application.

**Address**: deployed per application as a clone of the implementation.
**Source**: `src/midway/MidwayBatchAccount.sol`
